segments.source: For a first Bella Donovan pour-over, Blue Bottle's shared Signature Blends guide specifies 27 g coffee to 350 g water, a medium grind and a 195–205°F water range, with a 2:30–3:30 drawdown target. It advises starting darker roasts toward the cooler end. That makes a concrete paper-filter experiment for this dark US blend; it does not establish the ideal temperature for your water or prove any raspberry note will appear. Keep this recipe separate from a French-press or espresso setting. Checked October 26, 2026.

segments.source: Onyx now publishes a Southern Weather espresso starting point in its own brew guide: 20 g coffee to 45 g beverage, with a 25-second nine-bar stage in the roaster's Series 1 profile. Its separate Kalita filter start is 25 g to 300 g water at 200°F. The earlier 19 g to 40 g figure came from Fellow's retail sample and should not be presented as the only documented espresso route. Use these as different brewer-specific starts, then adjust the delivered bag and your own basket. Checked October 26, 2026.

segments.source: Peet's current Big Bang page recommends cold brew alongside French press and pour-over, and describes its cold-brew method as a 12-hour-plus cold steep. That is a different plan from pouring hot coffee over ice: prepare it ahead and check the actual whole-bean stock before planning a batch. The page still shows a sold-out notice for the selected direct listing at this check, while displaying a price label; neither that label nor the capsules and pods shown nearby establishes an available whole-bean offer. Checked October 26, 2026.

segments.source: Verve's current Streetlevel page now gives distinct device-specific starts: 19.5–20.1 g coffee to 27–32 g beverage for espresso, 54 g to 810 g water for a coffee maker, and 35 g to 500 g for French press. The short espresso beverage is not the same ratio as a full drip pot, so a household sharing this bag needs separate grinder references. These are Verve's suggested recipes, not Coffeedant brews or a guarantee about the next blend lot. Checked October 26, 2026.
